evidence_scope_note: The paper-validation run binds 28 full-paper reads, 45 physically re-derived paper/code locators, exact source versions, a dynamic context graph, a root-authored decision ledger, and an unexecuted minimum Study A proposal. Prior results only motivate methods and counterevidence. No Study A episode, harness efficacy result, or field-instance outcome exists.
variant: 43-source nine-area adaptive research design with preregistration-ready 2x2 Study A and deferred H-E routing

structured_expectations.context_graph_literature_role: hypothesis, method, comparator, interpretation, and counterevidence input; never a gate that establishes local efficacy

dangling_reference_scan.note: receipt path strings must resolve to files that exist in the repository
dangling_reference_scan.external_artifact_policy: upstream source archives are re-fetchable and are recorded with a fetch url and digest rather than committed; the gate requires both and spot re-fetches are recorded in a receipt

abstract_claim_consistency.note: the abstract must not claim non-execution while executed receipts exist, and headline counts must come from those receipts

evidence_chain_gate.note: the claim level is local and runs on every validation; the byte level needs the network, is run on request, and is checked here only for staleness

preregistration_gate.note: the document must be frozen and complete; once episodes exist beyond the frozen count it may no longer change

manuscript_source_note: switches to quarto when the Korean source reaches citation parity with the draft; the artifact gate enforces the reference count so the flag cannot be flipped early without failing

receipt_provenance.rule: Any receipt under paper/experiments/ that asserts execution must declare origin and its usage evidence.
receipt_provenance.legacy_note: Frozen, enumerated set of receipts executed before this gate. Each must declare origin, model_id, protocol_fingerprint, evidence_level EXECUTED_LEGACY_UNINSTRUMENTED and a provenance_gap string. No receipt may be added to this list without a new decision record. New receipts must carry full fields.
receipt_provenance.orx_binding_rule: A receipt claiming execution must name the immutable run that produced it; the gate verifies the run exists in the local run store, has status 'done', and that node_commit matches the run commit. Episodes executed outside a run are not admissible as results.

invariants: A number that did not come from a model call, a verifier run, or a human measurement never enters a result table, figure, ledger rationale, or graph result node. Simulation is permitted only as an instrument test fixture or a labelled power/sample-size calculation. Every artefact carrying results has an origin field.

study_b.seal_commit_note: v4: task adapter conventions stated and best_config scored semantically after the 3-episode pilot exposed verifier underspecification. Pilot episodes are PRE_V4_PILOT and excluded from the block.
